sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: The example is from a different context than the problems below.

items.prompt: A line of fit is y = 3x + 2. Predict y for x = 4.

steps: Identify the quantities and the applicable model.
Check that the result answers the question.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A data set has x-values from 2 through 13. A prediction is made at x = 7. Is this interpolation or extrapolation?
A cylinder and cone each have radius 3 units and height 15 units. Which has the greater volume?
Umbrella sales and rainy-day traffic delays are correlated. Which conclusion is justified?
choices: There is no relationship at all.
They are correlated; this alone does not prove causation.

items.prompt: Find the exact volume of a cylinder with radius 3 units and height 6 units. Express your answer as a rational multiple of π.
Find the exact volume of a cone with radius 2 units and height 21 units. Express your answer as a rational multiple of π.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: These are meant to be hard. Show the reasoning even if you do not finish.

items.prompt: Find the exact volume of a sphere with radius 6 units. Express your answer as a rational multiple of π.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A cylinder and cone each have radius 6 units and height 12 units. Which has the greater volume?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: As x increases, y generally increases. What association does this scatter plot describe?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
